target_customer: Small commercial trucking firms, contractors and small businesses needing commercial insurance
problem: Small businesses struggle to get the right coverage and certificates fast. Redoubt operates as a licensed brokerage on its own software, aiming to become an autonomous insurance carrier.
business_model: Insurance brokerage commissions, with a goal of becoming a carrier
product_category: Commercial insurance brokerage with AI automation

founders.name: Andre Beukers
education: Princeton University, PhD in AI models of human cognition
founders.background_notes: Holds the insurance license and runs the brokerage on software he builds, per the YC page. Sole founder.

competitors.name: Nirvana Insurance
competitors.traction_then: Raised 100M USD Series D per trade press

competitors.name: Corgi Insurance
competitors.what: Full stack AI insurance platform that entered trucking on 2026-07-13

competitors.name: Cover Whale
competitors.what: Dynamic trucking insurance, also a carrier partner named on Redoubt's site

technical_complexity.rationale: Brokerage workflow automation is standard engineering, but becoming a carrier needs underwriting models, capital and licensing.

defensibility.rationale: Licensing is a barrier only to entry as a broker, which is easy; carrier status would be harder but is not yet achieved.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: AI native insurers were already well funded; no action against Redoubt found.

market_need_then: Trucking insurance premiums and certificate friction burden small carriers; AI native insurers raised large rounds in 2023 to 2025 showing demand.

identity.logo: A logo image exists per a directory; design not described
identity.visual_style: Local agency style site with tools such as a Utah contractor setup checker

brand_strength.rationale: A redoubt is a fortification, which suggests safety suited to insurance, but no source states this, and no brand press exists.

outcome_analysis: Redoubt is a one person Fall 2026 company that today is an independent brokerage with an ambition to become an autonomous carrier. No exit or funding was verified. The path to carrier status needs capital and licensing, and well funded AI insurers already target trucking.
notes: Dealroom lists a 500k USD seed with no investor and a San Francisco location; single aggregator, unverified, not recorded as a round. YC and the company site say Salt Lake City. The name origin meaning of redoubt as a fortification is dictionary meaning and is not sourced as intent.
